state:
**Side goal `website-overhaul`: stage 6 (In-Depth, the home page and the last links) has one item left: the plain-English read of the whole site, then closing the goal.**

In-Depth has its eight sections: `what-for`, `never`, `how-we-decide`, `design-principles`, `concepts/` (an index and five pages), `falls-behind`, `roadmap` and `what-changed`, each in the In-Depth sidebar in that order. Each essay links decision records through `decisionRecord` from `@config/site.mjs`, as `<a href={decisionRecord('NNNN')}>`, and never prints a record number.

The home page (`website/src/content/docs/index.mdx`) has a short hero, one `<Snippet src="home/greetings.nvs">`, six standout features linking to their Why-Novis pages, and four `LinkCard`s built from `AREAS`. The six are a proposal: the user reviews them when the goal lands. `sponsoring.mdx` keeps the user's own voice, and only its dashes and two long sentences were split.

`bun nv site --check in-depth` is `inDepthProblems` in `tools/nv/cmd/site.ts`, driven by `IN_DEPTH_SECTIONS`. `structure` now also fails on any page link or sidebar link that `builtUrls` does not list (each handwritten page, the Core class and method pages, the Configuration and CLI pages). No `LATER` stub is left.

Green in this session: `site structure`, `in-depth`, `prose`, `snippets`, `stale`, `--build`, `bun test tools/nv/test/site.test.ts` (18 pass) and `bun nv verify`. `reference`, `syntax`, `guides` and `apps` were not rerun. This session did not touch them.

items.text: **The plain-English read of the whole site**: one `Explore` subagent that did not write the pages reads every handwritten page under `website/src/content/docs/` against `AGENTS.md` § *Text an end user reads*, and returns `file:line` plus the rule it breaks. Rewrite each flagged passage from what it means to say. Never trim it until `--check prose` passes. Specified by `docs/agent/goals/side/website-overhaul.md` § Stage 6, last bullet. Anchors: `website/src/content/docs/in-depth/index.mdx:1`, `website/src/content/docs/index.mdx:1`

**Close the goal**: `bun nv verify --doc` and fix every broken link it names, then `bun nv owners --closes website-overhaul`. Run every `bun nv site --check` part, `--build` and `bun test tools/nv/test/site.test.ts`. Then write `DONE`. The record's `sweep: "done"` means the driver sweeps only after that. Anchors: `tools/nv/cmd/site.ts:64`

backlog: The six standout features on the home page and the 11 Why-Novis pages wait for the user's review when the goal lands (`docs/agent/goals/side/website-overhaul.md` § Standing decisions).
`in-depth/what-changed.mdx` is a sample release, marked as one. The first numbered release replaces it.
`in-depth/roadmap.mdx` lists what is built and what comes next from `docs/plan/m9.md` to `docs/plan/m17.md`. A session that closes one of those plan files rewrites that list.
